result.description:
Motor Mechanic 
Davey Automotive Services – Breakwater, VIC, 3219
Permanent, full-time | $79,423 plus superannuation 

About us

Davey Automotive Services is a professional automotive workshop based in Breakwater, providing mechanical repairs, servicing and vehicle support for private, commercial and fleet customers.

The business specialises in scheduled servicing, diagnostics, mechanical repairs, vehicle inspections, roadworthy requirements, parts support and after-sales care. With experience across all makes and models, Davey Automotive Services delivers practical, reliable and detail-focused automotive services tailored to our customer’s needs.

The workshop is operated with a strong focus on workmanship, safety and customer confidence. Each vehicle is assessed and prepared with care to ensure it meets expected standards of performance, reliability and roadworthiness.

The role 

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Motor Mechanic to join our team. The role involves maintaining, testing, diagnosing and repairing petrol engines and the mechanical parts of lightweight motor vehicles, including transmissions, suspension, steering and braking systems.

You will be responsible for carrying out scheduled servicing, fault diagnosis, repairs, parts replacement and performance testing in accordance with manufacturer specifications, service manuals and workshop procedures. The role requires accurate diagnosis of mechanical and electrical faults, safe dismantling and reassembly of vehicle components, and the use of appropriate hand tools, workshop equipment and computer-based diagnostic systems.

The successful candidate will be expected to work efficiently within a busy workshop, maintain accurate records of work completed, support the preparation and ongoing servicing of vehicles, and ensure all work is completed safely and to the required standard.

Flexibility is essential, as the role may involve working across business operating hours, including Saturdays.

Key duties and responsibilities 

- Maintain, test and repair petrol engines and mechanical components of lightweight motor vehicles.
- Detect and diagnose mechanical and electrical faults in engines, transmissions, suspension, steering, braking systems and related vehicle components.
- Use computer-based diagnostic equipment, testing procedures and road testing where required to identify faults and confirm repair outcomes.
- Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and inspect parts for wear, damage or defects.
- Repair, adjust or replace worn, damaged or defective parts and reassemble mechanical components with reference to service manuals and manufacturer specifications.
- Perform scheduled maintenance services, including oil changes, lubrication, filter replacement, safety checks and engine tune-ups, to support smooth vehicle operation and compliance with pollution requirements.
- Reassemble engines and mechanical parts after repairs have been completed.
- Test and adjust repaired mechanical parts and systems to ensure proper performance, roadworthiness and safe operation. 
- Inspect vehicles and identify work required to achieve roadworthiness, where required and where permitted by applicable regulatory requirements.
- Maintain accurate records of inspections, servicing, repairs, parts used and work completed.
- Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop and ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements at all times.

Required qualifications and experience 

- Certificate III in automotive mechanical technology at least two (2) years of relevant experience; or
- Certificate IV or higher in automotive mechanical technology and at least one (1) year of relevant experience; or
- At least three (3) years of highly relevant work experience may substitute for the above formal qualifications.

How to apply 

We welcome applications from all appropriately qualified candidates. We are committed to a fair, inclusive recruitment process, and we will consider applicants based on skills, experience and role requirements.

Please submit your application through the recruitment platform for this advertisement.
Your application should include:

- A current resume outlining your relevant qualifications and work experience; and 
- A brief cover letter addressing your suitability for the role. 

To ensure all applications are properly received and assessed, please submit your application via one platform only and do not to apply through multiple job portals.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Closure date:	30 Days

Position Overview: Mygration is engaged to source the following position for our client
Our client is a leading innovator in the design, fabrication, and installation of high-quality steel structures and electrical systems for industrial and commercial applications. With a strong focus on engineering excellence, safety, and precision, they deliver cutting-edge solutions across various sectors, including infrastructure, energy, and manufacturing.

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Engineering Technician to join their dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting the design, installation, and maintenance of electrical systems for heavy machinery, substations, and industrial control systems. You will work closely with engineers and technologists to ensure all electrical installations meet industry standards, safety regulations, and project specifications.

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical skills and a passion for electrical systems within an industrial and structural engineering environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design & Documentation:
• Prepare detailed electrical drawings, schematics, and layout plans for industrial installations, including substations, switchgear, motor control systems, and cabling networks.
• Develop wiring diagrams and termination schedules for control panels used in heavy machinery & manufacturing and automation systems.

Technical Support:
• Assist electrical engineers in the design, testing, and optimization of electrical systems for machinery & manufacturing and structural projects.
• Troubleshoot and diagnose faults in PLC-controlled systems, including servo drives and variable frequency drives (VFDs).

Testing & Analysis:
• Conduct electrical tests, perform complex calculations, and analyse data to validate system performance.
• Perform insulation resistance (IR) testing, earth continuity checks, and thermal imaging on high-voltage equipment.

Cost Estimation:
• Assist in estimating material quantities, costs, and project timelines.
• Evaluate supplier quotations for electrical components (e.g., circuit breakers, contactors) to ensure cost-effective procurement.

Quality Assurance:
• Inspect electrical installations and finished products for compliance with specifications.
• Verify that all electrical work adheres to AS/NZS 3000 and IEC standards before commissioning.

Installation & Maintenance:
• Assemble, install, calibrate, and repair electrical equipment, including protection relays and metering devices.
• Perform preventive maintenance on industrial motor control centres (MCCs) to minimize downtime.

Workshop Operations:
• Undertake workshop duties, including wiring, testing, and modifying electrical assemblies.
• Fabricate and test custom control panels for machinery integration.

Research & Development:
• Contribute to R&D initiatives by assisting in experimental programs.
• Assist in the testing and integration of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar inverters) into industrial power networks.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:
• Trade Certification or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
• Proven experience in electrical drafting, machinery wiring, or industrial electrical systems and manufacturing fabrications.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical) for schematic and layout design.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to perform technical calculations and interpret test data.
• Knowledge of industry standards, including AS/NZS 3000 and electrical safety regulations.
• Hands-on experience with motor controls, switchgear, PLCs, and protection systems is highly desirable.
• Workshop & fabrication skills, including the ability to assemble and troubleshoot electrical components.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and project teams.
• At least 2 years of Full-time on the job work experience.

WHY APPLY?
• Work with a forward-thinking company at the forefront of industrial and structural engineering.
• Engage in high-impact projects involving cutting-edge electrical systems.
• Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
• Competitive remuneration and a supportive team environment.

If you are a motivated Electrical Engineering Technician with a passion for precision and innovation, we encourage you to apply! Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Please note: We are recruiting on behalf of our client. All applications will be treated with confidentiality.

Job Title: Metallurgical Technician (Metallurgical or Materials Technician - ANZSCO 312912) 
Company: Scidell Pty Ltd, allied company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd 
Location: St Elmo Site, Julia Creek QLD, Australia 
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time 
Recruitment managed by: Yakr Pty Ltd

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a scientific delivery alliancing company created to provide professional and cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources Pty Ltd (Multicom). Scidell’s multi-disciplined scientific and technical project professionals operate from Brisbane and on-site to deliver major projects from initial study through to execution, commissioning, and ongoing expert operational support. 

Multicom is on a mission to bring high-purity critical minerals to the world and become a reliable supplier for global technology manufacturers. Currently, Multicom is progressing the permitting, approval, and development of its 100% owned Saint Elmo Project, situated 25 km east of Julia Creek in Queensland's Northwest Minerals Province , focused on advancing the production of critical assets like vanadium and high-purity alumina (HPA). 

About the role:
As a Metallurgical Technician at Scidell, you will be a key member of the production and operations team responsible for monitoring and improving metallurgical performance targets for the Saint Elmo refinery and mine facility. Working under the direct supervision of the Process Supervisor, you will test materials, operate equipment, and optimize processes to ensure safe, efficient plant operations. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to apply technical data analysis and hands-on testing skills within a highly sophisticated minerals processing environment. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Process Optimization & Monitoring: Monitor various stages of the production process to ensure smooth operations. Check and adjust parameters such as temperature, pressure, flow rates, and chemical concentrations to maximize plant throughput, Vanadium/HPA recovery, and quality costs. 
•	Metallurgical Testing & Surveys: Undertake surveys, coordinate sampling activities, and execute test work to evaluate and identify process improvement opportunities. 
•	Equipment Operations: Start up, shut down, adjust, and operate plant machinery and equipment safely in strict accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
•	Equipment & Lab Performance: Monitor key equipment across both the process plant and the onsite laboratory to ensure components are optimized and alternative operational methods are assessed. 
•	Quality Control & Data Review: Conduct regular routine inspections and quality control checks on products and materials. Review operating and technical data to identify instances of noncompliance or opportunities for process optimization. 
•	Metallurgical Reporting: Maintain accurate records of equipment operations, process parameters, production, and testing activities. Generate precise metallurgical reconciliations and complete timely daily, weekly, and monthly reports. 
•	Troubleshooting & Technical Support: Identify and troubleshoot basic equipment issues, malfunctions, or process deviations. Provide expert technical support to operations, laboratory teams, and the senior process engineering team, collaborating closely on complex issues. 
•	Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to the Site Safety and Health Management System and all established SOPs, ensuring all safety hazards or incidents are reported promptly. 

Key Requirements:
•	Education: Bachelor's degree in Extractive Metallurgy, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering. 
•	Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar metallurgical or materials testing role, with solid practical experience testing materials within a mineral/metal process and refinery environment. 
•	Licences: Possession of (or the immediate ability to acquire) a Radiation Safety Licence and a Queensland Driver’s Licence (manual preferred). 
•	Technical Skills: Sound understanding of process control systems , mechanical aptitude or a strong interest in hands-on technical roles , and a proven ability to source, gather, interpret, and communicate quantitative and qualitative data. 
•	Personal Attributes: Highly detail-oriented, safety-conscious, willing to learn, and possessing a reliable and consistent work ethic. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow technical instructions accurately. 
•	Pre-Employment Screening: Must be able to pass a comprehensive Pre-Employment Medical examination, including a drug and alcohol screen. 

Why join Scidell?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive, cooperative, and collaborative environment. Be part of a dedicated team that values safety, high attention to detail, and innovation in delivering critical minerals to global markets. 

How to Apply: 
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume/CV, ensuring you highlight your relevant material testing, metallurgical data analysis, and engineering experiences.

We are seeking talented individuals to join our External Audit practise at KPMG.  We are open to full-time/part-time/casual/max-term/flexible working options.

IT External Audit
Our IT External Audit team assists our clients to meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines. We work as an integrated business and as part of a larger multi-disciplinary team. The team draws on a diverse and dedicated group of people, powerful KPMG methodologies, innovating capability and assets, and global resources to support our clients in achieving the right milestones. 

Audit & Assurance: External Audit
Our Audit teams provide value to our clients by delivering specialised quality audit and assurance services. High-quality, independent financial statement audits are essential to maintaining investor confidence. Our audit professionals are committed to the public interest, challenging assumptions, and unlocking valuable insights based on a solid understanding of an organisation’s business and industry.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems. 
•	You are a kind and compassionate leader with a passion for continually growing your leadership skills to get the best out of a diverse and multidisciplinary team.
•	You are a people-person with a love of sharing your Audit and Assurance insight and tailoring your communication appropriately for subject matter experts and clients who want to learn more.

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

IT External Audit
•	Experience in assisting clients meet their IT External audit requirements and timelines.
•	Supporting engagements in the preparation of clear and concise IT External Audit reports. 
•	Providing technical knowledge, direction, and training to engagement team members.
•	In a leadership role, manage small teams and oversee the planning and execution of IT External Audit client engagements
•	Supporting business proposals and business development activities by assisting in the identification of new target clients, building business relationships, and developing/presenting proposals/findings

Audit & Assurance: External Audit

•	Qualifications in CA/CPA and CISA/CISM/CRISC, and strong IFRS skills, will be viewed favourably.

Please note, the salary ranges $60k - $100k+ with respect to your level of experience.

Securing floor coverings and fitting edge trims in doorways
Sanding, staining and applying finishing coatings to timber floors

Ensure safe workplace, general warehouse upkeep
Strict compliance with company protocols and consistent observance of established safety standards

Trade qualified

Strong communication skills

Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

Have you used SQL, SSMS, BigQuery or similar tools to explore and validate data sources? Please provide an example.

What experience do you have working within Agile or project delivery environments?

Please advise your availability to commence employment and any notice period required.

Please outline your salary expectations (exclusive of superannuation).

For more information about the role, refer to the attached position description or contact talent@epworth.org.au or call (03) 9426 0606.

Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help us deliver smarter, data-driven healthcare solutions.

Apply now! Click I'm Interested and submit your CV and cover letter as a single document including brief responses to the selection criteria questions above.

Early applications are encouraged - shortlisting will commence immediately.

Apply now. we've over 8,000 perspectives at Epworth and we're ready to welcome yours!

It is a condition of employment with Epworth HealthCare, subject to reasonable exemptions, that you have had an annual Influenza vaccination, where this is required under Epworth policy.

As a child safe organisation, all successful applicants are required to satisfactorily clear a National Police Check (conducted by Epworth) and may be required to hold a valid employee Working with Children Check (provided by you).

At Epworth, we believe inclusion and diversity are essential to our culture and values. We focus on fairness and opportunity for all - across race, ability, ethnicity, gender, age, sexuality, cultures and beliefs - that reflect the communities we work in. At Epworth, we care.
